sources.note: Main product page for TenEleven under Ensora Health. Lists TheraNest and Fusion as sibling products. TenEleven described as behavioral health software with MAT, bed management, and adaptable documentation tools.

ONC mandatory disclosures for eCR v2.4. Lists single-patient and population export capabilities, associated software (eRx, Inpriva, Dynamic Health IT), FHIR endpoint at fhir.10e11.com, and pricing structure.

Original TenEleven features page — now redirects to Ensora Health. Cached/indexed content describes core functionality including Golden Thread documentation, FormLab, billing triggers, compliance management, dashboards, e-labs, e-prescribing, MAR, clinical event notifications, RCM.

TenEleven knowledge base organized into 8 sections: Get Started, Programs/Procedures/Visits, Staff/Users/Payers, MAT & ePrescribe, Billing/Claims/Payments, Reporting & Regulatory, Patient Management, Clinical Features & FormLab.

Third-party overview of TenEleven. Lists MAT, e-prescribing, client portal, billing/RCM, bed management, scheduling, BI analytics. Serves mental health, chemical health, substance abuse, residential/inpatient, outpatient. 4.2/5 rating across 19 reviews.

Lists features including appointment scheduling, charting, treatment planning, employee management, e-prescribing, clinician mapping, patient statements, form library, integrated credit card processing. Custom pricing. 4.2/5 rating.

2020 press release: TenEleven won contracts with 3 NJ substance use treatment agencies. Mentions integration with NJ HIEs, Prescription Drug Monitoring Program, and NJSAMS. 'Thousands of users in hundreds of offices.'
2020 press release: Greenwich House (NYC, ~15,000 clients/year) consolidated multiple EHRs and paper billing into eCR. Selected for being a 'one-stop-shop' for billing, incident management, and MAT.
April 2025 announcement of Therapy Brands rebranding to Ensora Health. Ensora unifies mental health, behavioral health, and rehabilitative therapy software solutions.

Confirms Therapy Brands (Lightyear Capital portfolio company) acquired TenEleven Group Inc. as part of a roll-up strategy. TenEleven described as SaaS company covering referral, scheduling, treatment, billing, discharge, and aftercare.
2021 announcement of KKR acquiring Therapy Brands (which includes TenEleven).
Company profile: TenEleven Group based in East Amherst, NY. Estimates ~23-30 employees. Focus on health and human services agencies.
